---
title: "Primitives & Verdicts"
---

Every built-in primitive, its signature, and the verdict types the LLM primitives use. This is
the facts tier; the [Guide](../guide/index.qmd) how-tos teach which one to reach for.

## At a glance

| Primitive | Action | Default events | Inline tests? | Reach for it when |
|-----------|--------|----------------|:-------------:|-------------------|
| `block_command` | block | `PreToolUse` | ✓ | Deny a Bash command outright |
| `warn_command` | warn | `PostToolUse` | ✓ | Flag a command without blocking |
| `gate` | block | `Stop \| SubagentStop` | ✓ | Require something done before the agent finishes |
| `nudge` | warn (or block) | see below | ✓ | Advise when conditions or signals fire |
| `lint` | warn (or block) | `PostToolUse` | ✓ | Check Python edits (string- or AST-mode) |
| `diff_lint` | warn (or block) | `PostToolUse` | ✓ | Flag only what an edit changed |
| `audit` | log | `PreToolUse \| PostToolUse \| Stop` | — | Append JSONL records of activity |
| `llm_gate` | block | `Stop \| SubagentStop` | SKIP | Block on a judgment a regex can't make |
| `llm_nudge` | warn | `PostToolUse` | SKIP | Advise on a judgment a regex can't make |
| `prompt_check` | warn/block | called in a handler | SKIP | Judge an edit inside a custom handler |
| `workflow` | block | `SubagentStop` | ✓ | Enforce an ordered, artifact-gated checklist |

Deterministic primitives carry inline `tests={...}`; LLM-backed ones show **SKIP** under
`uvx capt-hook test` because they need a real model. `nudge` defaults to `PreToolUse` with a `when=`
predicate, `PostToolUse` with `signals=`, and `Stop | SubagentStop` when `block=True`.

## Commands

```python
block_command(pattern: str | list[str], *, reason: str, hint: str | None = None,
              tests: InlineTests | None = None) -> None

warn_command(pattern: str | list[str], *, message: str, tests: InlineTests | None = None,
             events: Event = Event.PostToolUse) -> None
```

A token list (`["git", "stash"]`) becomes a whitespace-tolerant regex; a string is used as-is.

## Nudges & gates

```python
nudge(message: str, *, when=None, signals=None, only_if=(), skip_if=(), block=False,
      events=None, max_fires=None, tests=None, async_=False) -> None

gate(message: str, **kwargs) -> None   # == nudge(message, block=True, ...)
```

## Linting

```python
lint(check: Callable[[str], list[str]] | Callable[[ast.AST], Iterator[str]], *, message: str,
     trigger=None, sep=", ", block=False, events=None, tests=None, max_shown=5) -> None

diff_lint(check: Callable[[ast.AST, ast.AST], list[str]], *, message: str, sep=", ",
          block=False, events=None, tests=None, max_shown=5, only_if=..., skip_if=...) -> None
```

`lint` infers string- vs AST-mode from the check's first parameter type. `{violations}` in the
message is replaced with the joined results. Both fire on `.py` edits and skip test files.

## Audit

```python
audit(events=Event.PreToolUse | Event.PostToolUse | Event.Stop, *, log_dir=None,
      filename=lambda d: f"{d:%Y-%m-%d}.jsonl", fields=default_fields,
      only_if=(), skip_if=()) -> None
```

The default record fields are `ts`, `event`, `tool`, `file`, and `session_id`.

## LLM primitives

```python
llm_gate(prompt: str, *, message: str | Callable[[GateVerdict], str], verdict=lambda r: r.block,
         response_model=GateVerdict, only_if=(), skip_if=(), events=None, max_fires=None,
         model="small", agent=True, transcript=True, ...) -> None

llm_nudge(prompt: str, *, message: str | Callable[[NudgeVerdict], str], verdict=lambda r: r.fire,
          response_model=NudgeVerdict, max_fires=None, model="small", ...) -> None

prompt_check(evt, template: str | Prompt, fmt=None, *, prefix: str, suffix="", timeout=45,
             include_reasoning=True, response_model=PromptCheckVerdict) -> HookResult | None
```

`llm_gate` defaults to `max_fires=1`, `llm_nudge` to `max_fires=3`. `prompt_check` is called
from a handler and returns a `HookResult` (or `None`). Bound cost with `max_fires`, a narrow
`only_if`, and `model="small"`.

## Verdict types

| Type | Fields | Returned by |
|------|--------|-------------|
| `GateVerdict` | `block: bool`, `reasoning: str` | `llm_gate` |
| `NudgeVerdict` | `fire: bool`, `reasoning: str` | `llm_nudge` |
| `PromptCheckVerdict` | `action: "ok" \| "warning" \| "block"`, `reason: str` | `prompt_check` |

## Prompt builder

`Prompt` assembles a system prompt, XML-tagged context blocks, and an ask, then renders via
`str(prompt)`.

```python
Prompt().system("...").context("diff", diff_text).ask("Is this a real bug?")

Prompt.from_template("Review {file} for {issue}", file="x.py", issue="leaks")
Prompt.load("review/bug", base=None, **vars)   # renders captain_hook prompts/review/bug.md
```

`from_template` and `load` raise `KeyError` on a missing placeholder; `load` raises
`FileNotFoundError` when the `.md` file isn't found.
